articles.title: Apple Brings Dynamic Island to Mac for the First Time
articles.description: Apple today introduced the Dynamic Island to the Mac for the first time with its new 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models, bringing Live Activities, Spotlight, and Siri AI together in an interactive area of the display. The Dynamic Island first launched on the iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 14 Pro Max in September 2022. It replaced the notch with a smaller TrueDepth camera cutout surrounded by software that expands and changes shape to display alerts, ongoing Live Activities, and controls. The Mac version carries over the idea of keeping ongoing activities visible and accessible while users work in other apps. Apple says users can do things like answer a phone call, control music playback, and accept an AirDrop request through the interface. The Dynamic Island also serves as a location for Spotlight and Siri AI. With the new MacBook Pro's touchscreen, actions such as pausing a song can also simply be performed with a tap. While the original iPhone implementation incorporated the TrueDepth camera system used for Face ID, the new MacBook Pro retains Touch ID for authentication and features a 12-megapixel Center Stage camera. The arrival of the Dynamic Island therefore does not bring Face ID to the Mac. The new MacBook Pro models became available to pre-order on October 28 and launch on November 6. U.S. pricing starts at $2,899 for the 14-inch model and $3,399 for the 16-inch model. articles.title: 1991 BMW 325i Coupe 5-Speed at No Reserve
articles.description: This Lagoon Green Metallic 1991 BMW 325i coupe is said to have been purchased new by a US service member in Germany before it was relocated to the Pacific Northwest in 1992, and it was acquired by the current owner in 2007. The car has been retrofitted with 325is-style modifications including a 4.10 limited-slip differential, a revised engine management chip, Bilstein and Eibach suspension components, and 325is-specification lower bodywork. Powered by a 2.5-liter inline-six linked to a five-speed manual transmission, the car has been further modified with yellow fog light bulbs and LED city lights as well as a Supersprint rear resonator, a front strut tower brace, 16" O.Z. Racing wheels, a MOMO steering wheel, aftermarket pedal covers, and a Pioneer Premier stereo head unit. Additional equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes, cruise control, power windows, and front sport seats trimmed in black leather. This E30 coupe is now offered at no reserve by the seller on behalf of the owner with a spare set of Style 10 wheels with snow tires as well as manufacturer's literature, service records since 2007, a clean Carfax report, and a clean Washington title in the owner's name.
